description: This file declares the HttpDecoder class and related interfaces for decoding HTTP frames over QUIC, including visitor callbacks for different frame types and parsing logic.

classes.name: HttpDecoder
classes.description: Main class for decoding HTTP frames in QUIC, with callback interface for handling different frame types.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for receiving callbacks during HTTP frame decoding.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Options
classes.description: Configuration options for HttpDecoder, such as allowing WebTransport streams.

methods.name: HttpDecoder::ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data and invokes visitor callbacks until completion or error.

methods.name: HttpDecoder::DecodeSettings
methods.description: Decodes a SETTINGS frame from raw data into a SettingsFrame object.
